d:
Watch this Amazing Vedic Mantra with Pavitrikaran, Aachman, Pranayam, Gayatri Aawahanam, Dhyan "Aum Bhoor Bhuvaha Swaha, Tatsavitur Varenyam, Bhargo Devasya Dheemahi, Dheeyo Yo Nah Prachodayat.''
Singer: Hariharan
Album: Shree Gayatri Mantra
Composer: Shekhar Sen
Lyrics: Traditional
Music Label : T-Series
AUM - Almighty God
BHOOR - Embodiment of vital or spiritual energy, BHUVAHA - Destroyer of suffering, SWAHA - Embodiment of Happiness, TAT - That (indicating God)
